column3: a newcomer is oriented in half a page, exclusions and contacts explicit
column6: A newcomer is oriented in half a page: what the system does, what state it is in, what is explicitly out of scope, and who to contact. No course jargon.
column9: The overview orients a reader, but exclusions or contacts are vague, or it takes considerably longer than half a page to get the picture.
column12: No usable overview, or a reader cannot tell what the system does or what state it is in.

column2: Setup: complete, copy-pasteable, verified by a fresh run [SO2]
column3: complete, copy-pasteable, and actually verified by a fresh run
column6: Setup instructions are complete and copy-pasteable, and the team verified them from a clean environment. A grader following them cold reaches a running system.
column9: Setup is mostly right but has gaps: an undocumented prerequisite, a step that fails without a stated workaround, or no evidence of a fresh-run verification.
column12: Setup cannot be followed to a running system.

column3: prioritized, severities and credential transfer covered, candid tone
column6: Known issues are prioritized with severities, credential and account transfer is covered, and the tone is candid rather than promotional.
column9: Issues and future work are listed but unprioritized, missing severities, or silent on credential transfer.
column12: No known-issues section, or it omits problems the team is aware of.

column3: all four linked and current, decision record reachable
column6: All four living docs are linked and current, and the decision record is reachable from the handoff.
column9: Docs are linked but one is stale, or the decision record is hard to find.
column12: Living docs are missing, unlinked, or clearly out of date.

column2: Checklist, partner confirmation, and release consent [SO4]
column3: Checklist, written partner confirmation, and release-consent declaration all complete
column6: Handoff checklist complete, written partner confirmation attached, and the release-consent declaration lists every team member, with any NDA or partner restriction noted.
column9: Checklist and confirmation present, but one element is incomplete: a missing confirmation, an unnamed member, or an unstated restriction.
column12: No written partner confirmation, or the consent declaration is missing or incomplete.
